name: What is the best time of year to start duplex construction?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to start a duplex build in Los Angeles to avoid weather and scheduling delays?
mainEntity.text: When is the best time to start a duplex build in Los Angeles to avoid weather and scheduling delays?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Los Angeles, weather is generally workable much of the year, so the best start time is often determined more by permitting and contractor availability than by seasonal conditions alone. Dry months can make site work, grading, and foundation preparation easier, especially on sloped or exposed lots. However, if the design is not approved or the subcontractor team is not ready, waiting for a perfectly timed season can backfire. The ideal strategy is to align construction start with permit readiness, procurement, and mobilization capacity. Owners should also consider market timing, financing milestones, and whether they want to avoid working around rain-sensitive phases. For many projects, the biggest schedule advantage comes from entering construction with complete documents and no unresolved city comments. A strong preconstruction plan is more valuable than picking the “perfect” month.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best start time is usually when permits are ready and the contractor can mobilize with a clear schedule, not just when the weather looks ideal. Dry months can help with grading and foundation work, but labor availability and plan approval often matter more. Starting too early without permits can cause bigger delays.
